Grouping and sorting depend on the lifecycle helpers, which are not reviewed here.

terms.meaning: a piece of work with no 3D shape that is tracked in the list

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports and display limit
sections.what: Brings in the React tools, the story and date-set types, and the lifecycle helpers. It sets the limit of 40 items shown per group.
sections.why: The list needs these tools, and the limit keeps the page fast.
sections.watch_out: The limit only changes what is shown, not the counts.

sections.name: day
sections.title: Formatting a day
sections.what: Turns a timestamp into a date text such as year-month-day, or a dash when there is none.
sections.why: Gives each item a short date that fits on one line.
sections.watch_out: The date is taken in UTC, so near midnight a date can appear one day off for viewers in other time zones.

sections.name: WorkChecklist (part 1)
sections.title: Filtering and grouping the items
sections.what: Keeps the stage filter and search text in state, filters the checklist items, groups each one by state on the chosen date, and sorts each group.
sections.why: Lets the viewer narrow the list and see the most relevant items first.
sections.watch_out: Items without a finish are sorted to the end, which may hide them when the list is long.

sections.name: WorkChecklist (part 2)
sections.title: Drawing each group of items
sections.what: Draws one group with its heading and count, each item as a button with a status mark, its stage, its code and its dates, and a note for physical work that is not modelled. It also says how many more items are hidden.
sections.why: Lets the viewer read and select each item.
sections.watch_out: Selecting an item shows its details elsewhere, so a stale selection can point at an item no longer shown.

sections.name: WorkChecklist (part 3)
sections.title: Progress header and filters
sections.what: Draws the overall progress, a progress bar, a note on how ticks are decided, the stage filter, the search box, and the four groups in order.
sections.why: Gives the viewer the summary and the controls.
sections.watch_out: The note says ticks are not proof of completion on planned dates, so the viewer should read it before trusting a tick.

summary: A searchable checklist of work that makes no change in the 3D view, such as approvals, design and testing. Items are grouped as in progress, up next, passed or undated, and are ticked as playback passes their finish.
purpose: Lets the viewer follow non-physical work that a 3D view cannot show.
why: Likely reason: some work has no geometry, so it needs a list to be visible at all.
how: It filters the stories to checklist items, applies the stage filter and search text, groups each item by its state on the chosen date, sorts the groups, and shows progress as a percentage with a list of up to 40 items per group.
inputs: The activity stories, the current date, the date set, the selected story identifier and a selection action.
outputs: A progress summary, a stage filter, a search box, and four grouped lists with dates and short notes.
risks: Only the first 40 items in each group are shown. Ticks on planned, forecast or baseline dates mean the playback passed the date, not that the work is really complete.
debug: If an item is missing, check its stage and whether it is a checklist item. If a date looks one day off, check the day formatting. If a tick looks wrong, check the date set.
